Color Palette Generator – Color Wheel Tool | Adobe Express

name: Adobe Color
summary: Palette explorer and generator: browse trending palettes, mix schemes on the color wheel and extract colors from images.
description: Browse trending color palettes and curated themes by mood, style or season, or build a palette from a base color with the interactive color wheel and color harmonies (monochromatic, complementary, analogous, triadic). Tools include image palette extraction, gradient extraction and a contrast checker, plus color meaning pages. Palettes can be saved to a Creative Cloud library and brought into Adobe Express.
contains: palette explorer filtered by mood, style and season
tools: color wheel, contrast checker, gradient extractor, image palette extractor
color meaning pages for orange, indigo, red, gold, coral, pink, blue, purple, green, yellow, silver, black and white
themes: vaporwave, synthwave, summer, neutral vintage, luxury, travel
palettes save to a Creative Cloud library; auto-applying them needs a paid plan
